nodes.label: Tasks Template
nodes.rationale: Template for /speckit.tasks output. Phases: Setup, Foundational (blocks all stories), User Story phases (P1 MVP first, each independently testable), Polish. Task format: [ID] [P?] [Story] Description. Dependency ordering enforces TDD (tests FAIL before implementation).

hyperedges.label: Spec Kit Lifecycle Pipeline
hyperedges.rationale: spec-template → plan-template → tasks-template form the mandatory ordered pipeline for feature development; each stage explicitly depends on outputs of the prior stage.
